name: Adobe
tagline: Software to create, manage and deliver digital content and customer experiences
facts: Anil Chakravarthy from 1 Dec 2026 (Narayen to Exec Chair)
Major R&D hub: Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Changing the world through personalized digital experiences

strategy.label: Responsible AI
strategy.text: Firefly trained on licensed content; Content Credentials to show how content was made

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: AI-first creativity and marketing; creation for everyone, depth for pros and enterprises

strategy.label: Two customer groups
strategy.text: Business Professionals and Consumers; Creative and Marketing Professionals

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Is Adobe balancing pro depth with mass-market simplicity, or stretched between the two?

customers.pain: Need precise control, fast turnaround and client-safe assets across image, video and 3D
customers.why: Industry-standard tools and file formats; one integrated suite; commercially safe AI

customers.pain: Must produce huge volumes of on-brand content for many channels, quickly
customers.why: GenStudio, Firefly, Frame.io and Express connect creation, review and delivery

customers.pain: Editing, reviewing, signing and making sense of long documents
customers.why: Adobe invented PDF; Acrobat is the trusted default, now with AI Assistant and Sign

customers.pain: Want good-looking content without design skills or big budgets
customers.why: Free Express and Firefly tiers, templates, brand trust (Canva is the strong rival here)

customers.pain: Fragmented customer data, weak personalisation, hard to prove marketing ROI
customers.why: End-to-end stack from content to customer data to delivery, tied to creative tools

products.name: Photoshop
products.desc: Image editing, compositing and retouching, with AI Generative Fill

products.name: Illustrator
products.desc: Vector graphics for logos, icons and illustrations

products.name: Premiere Pro
products.desc: Professional video editing for film, YouTube and social

products.name: Lightroom
products.desc: Photo organising and editing across desktop and mobile

products.name: Frame.io
products.desc: Cloud video review, feedback and collaboration

portfolio.north_star: Weekly active paid creators exporting finished work
portfolio.key_metrics: Creative Cloud net new ARR; Paid subscriber retention (churn rate)
portfolio.guardrails: App performance (crash rate, launch time); Cancellation complaints and NPS

products.name: Firefly
products.desc: Gen AI for image, video, audio, vector; commercially safe, IP indemnity

products.name: Firefly Foundry
products.desc: Custom models trained on a brand's own assets for enterprises

products.name: Adobe Express
products.desc: Quick templates for social posts, flyers and short videos

products.name: Adobe in ChatGPT
products.desc: Photoshop, Express and Acrobat usable directly inside ChatGPT

portfolio.north_star: Weekly AI-generated assets that are exported or published
portfolio.key_metrics: Free to paid conversion; Monthly active users of Express and Firefly
portfolio.guardrails: Inference cost per generation (margin); IP or unsafe content incidents

products.name: Acrobat Reader
products.desc: Free PDF viewer; top of the funnel with a massive user base

products.name: Acrobat Pro
products.desc: Create, edit, convert, compare and protect PDFs

products.name: Acrobat AI Assistant
products.desc: Chat with, summarise and query documents

portfolio.north_star: Documents actioned per week (edited, signed, summarised)
portfolio.key_metrics: Reader to paid Acrobat conversion; AI Assistant attach rate
portfolio.guardrails: Security and privacy incidents; Free Reader quality

products.name: AEM
products.desc: Manage websites, content and digital assets at scale

products.name: Real-Time CDP
products.desc: Unify customer data into live profiles for targeting

products.name: GenStudio
products.desc: AI content supply chain to plan, create and activate content

products.name: Marketo Engage
products.desc: B2B marketing automation and lead management

products.name: Semrush
products.desc: SEO and AI search visibility (acquisition announced Nov 2025)

portfolio.north_star: Personalised customer journeys activated for enterprise clients
portfolio.key_metrics: Net revenue retention; Products adopted per customer
portfolio.guardrails: Platform uptime against SLA; Time to value

rows.who_uses: Individual creatives, in-house design teams, students
rows.who_pays: Individuals on monthly or annual plans; employers buy seats
rows.how: Per-seat subscription, single app or full suite; student discounts

rows.who_uses: Casual creators, SMBs, social and marketing teams
rows.who_pays: Most use free; power users upgrade; enterprises pay for Foundry
rows.how: Freemium plus generative credit tiers ($9.99 to $199.99 per month)

rows.who_uses: Anyone who opens a PDF (free Reader)
rows.who_pays: Professionals and companies buying Acrobat seats
rows.how: Per-seat subscription; AI Assistant as paid add-on

rows.who_uses: Marketers, analysts, web and data teams
rows.who_pays: CMO and CIO budgets via multi-year enterprise contracts
rows.how: Priced by usage (profiles, traffic, volume) plus services

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Subscription is $6.58B of $6.76B Q3 revenue (up 14% YoY)

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Huge free user base (Reader, Express, Firefly) is the acquisition funnel; in B2B, users rarely hold the budget

bullets.label: Channels
bullets.text: adobe.com and app stores for individuals; direct enterprise sales and resellers for teams

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Free to paid upgrades, cross-sell across suites, AI credit upsell, price increases

bullets.label: Structure
bullets.text: Now one reporting segment for unified selling and product development

friction: Steep learning curve on pro apps
Confusing credit system; premium features drain credits fast
Native AI output often trails best rivals

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Pro tools, brand trust, safe AI, content-to-marketing workflow

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: AI-native tools make creation cheap for non-pros

news.label: Sep 2026
news.text: CEO transition; record Q3, guidance raised

news.label: AI push
news.text: Heavy spend on AI models and agentic apps; Firefly Foundry

news.label: Distribution
news.text: Semrush deal; apps inside ChatGPT; Runway, YouTube, Google Cloud partnerships

news.label: Watch
news.text: Stock down on free-tier shift, AI costs, AI-native rivals

sources: Adobe newsroom and Q3 FY26 results, SEC 10-Q, analyst coverage. Suite metrics are PM estimates for interview prep, not Adobe-published. Prepared Sep 2026.
